_comment: SAME reasoning as aws/raw/lifecycle-policy.json on the primary bucket, and
it applies with EQUAL force here: this bucket exists specifically to hold
the copy nothing can touch. The ONE rule is AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload
— it cannot delete or move a completed object. No Expiration, no
ever, on this bucket. D9 (voice retained FOREVER) governs this copy as
Once Object Lock is enabled at bucket creation (create-backup-bucket.sh),
Object Lock's own retention period is the durability control — this
lifecycle file's job is only to clean up abandoned multipart uploads,
APPLY (founder only): aws s3api put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration --bucket agrisync-raw-backup-ap-south-2 --lifecycle-configuration file://backup-lifecycle-policy.json --region ap-south-2
